name: linear-tv-indexed-cpp
title: Indexed cost per point, with a market index fixed after booking
description: A pricing model for Dutch-style linear TV and radio (Ster, Ad Alliance NL, Talpa). The rate per rating point is base price x indices fixed at booking x a market index the seller fixes after booking, capped for early requests. The buyer signs the formula, the cap, and the fixing date, not a number; the seller fixes the index later and invoices delivered points at the fixed rate. Core cpp cannot express this, because its fixed_price binds at acceptance. A buyer without this extension cannot buy the option, so the branch is must-understand.
origin: Rate-card market survey: Ster fixes the market index the day after the request deadline; early requests are capped at 100

extends.semantics: A pricing option and an accepted purchase pricing. Spend = delivered rating points x the fixed rate; until the seller fixes the market index, the rate is at most ceiling_price. Delivery reports use the core cpp metric (rating points) and spend in the option currency.
Readback in get_media_buys: the market index the seller fixed per purchase and the resulting rate. The seller announces each fixing through the core change feed.
Where this seller offers the model and which audience currencies it settles on.

promotion.rule: Stays an extension unless a second market adopts post-booking index fixing (rate-card market survey: a NL and Ad Alliance DE convention)

The spec and manifest text follow the documentation style guide; the rules and their IDs are unchanged.
